audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claimed Lucian owns Levels 1 and 4-5 and only 'Skill' from 6 onward, against a 42.86% Emerald+ win rate and the packet chart (Skill, Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Ryze, Ryze, Ryze).
audit.why: Neither champion has a combo at Level 1 (Lucian Q is 9s at rank 1; Ryze has Overload alone), and from Level 6 Ryze's mana/Lost Chapter spike plus a Flux-enabled root chain is a clear owner, not a skill test.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Lucian / Lucian / Skill / Ryze / Ryze / Ryze in both layers, with matching whys.

audit.why: Spikes list Lvl 2, Lvl 3, Lvl 6 (Tear/Lost Chapter) and 2+ items (Archangel's + Rod of Ages) — all four entries present and correctly ordered against Lucian's front-loaded curve.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison described repeatedly as a 'point-blank root'. It is 615 range and it only roots a target already carrying Flux from Spell Flux (E); on a clean target it is a damage + slow.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' This is the decisive lane interaction — dodging E, not W, is what defuses his lockdown, and it is what makes Lucian's E (445 range, 16s at rank 1) survivable.
audit.corrected: Track Spell Flux (615 range, 3.5s at rank 1). If E misses, W is only a slow. Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ryze.json Riot description, W and E ranges/cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block gave no numbers and repeated the point-blank-root error.
audit.why: Concrete numbers make the advice actionable: W 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, E 3.5s down to 2.5s, R 180/160/140.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with 615 range, 11s W, and the Flux precondition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Do #3 ('Shove crash-waves and roam mid') carried an unrelated body about Ryze spending Rune Prison early.
audit.why: Realm Warp is a 180s ally-group teleport with a delay, not a personal escape or a fast lane answer, so a crashed wave genuinely buys the roam.
audit.corrected: Body replaced with the Realm Warp fact.

edits.before: Passive double-shots win level 1 outright — Q through the wave on his last-hits and weave doubletaps on every step-up.
edits.after: Neither has a combo — Overload alone is 5s, your Q is 9s at rank 1, so it's last-hit trading and a race to Level 2.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Rune Prison (Root) — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Spell Flux then Rune Prison is a root, not a slow — with mana behind him the chain trades even, so step up only on his E miss.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Lost Chapter lands and Rune Prison roots you mid-dash — channelling The Culling hands him a still target.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: His first item out-ranges you and Flux resets Overload every 5s — force kills before it, because after it you cannot.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Archangel's plus Rod of Ages makes him a raid boss — convert to towers and roams, never a duel you cannot win.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: 615 range, 11s at rank 1 — it only roots if Spell Flux hit you first, so dodge the E and the W is just a slow. - Your E dash has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots through Spell Flux — if his E missed, W is a slow and your step-in is free. 11s down.

edits.before: Ryze spends Rune Prison (Root) early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Realm Warp is a 180s group teleport, not an escape — crash and roam mid, he cannot answer.

edits.before: Track Ryze’s Rune Prison (Root): Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Spell Flux, not Rune Prison: the W only roots a Flux'd target. Dodge the E at 615 and his lockdown is a slow.

notes: Packet reports only 14 games at 42.86% Emerald+ for this matchup (top-level games field says 787); chart aligned to the packet chart and the losing win rate. Rune Prison was described as a 'point-blank root' in four places — it is 615 range and roots only through Spell Flux. dontsFull[2] has a title ('Let him farm even') that does not match its body (a bad-trade description); left alone rather than guessed at.
